es.title: Empecemos por entender qué necesita resolver.
es.text: No necesita llegar con una solución definida. Cuéntenos el objetivo, el contexto y el reto; le ayudamos a encontrar el punto de partida adecuado.

en.title: Let’s start by understanding what you need to solve.
en.text: You don’t need to arrive with a defined solution. Tell us the goal, the context, and the challenge; we help you find the right starting point.
en.visualLabel: Two people reviewing a process map to define the next step

image.alt: Two people at a desk reviewing a process diagram, a laptop, and a phone.
